name: badge-radix
title: Badge
description: A compact label with two independent axes: a visual treatment (solid, soft, outline, ghost, link) and a semantic tone for status color.
author: Design From <https://labs.designfrom.com>
docs:
Installed `badge.tsx` in `components/ui`.

Import: `import { Badge, badgeVariants } from "@/components/ui/badge"`

```tsx
<Badge tone="success" variant="soft">Approved</Badge>
```

Colors and radius come from your theme's shadcn tokens (--primary, --border, --radius, and so on).
This item added its own variables to your CSS: `--badge-destructive-foreground`, `--badge-info`, `--badge-info-foreground`, `--badge-success`, `--badge-success-foreground`, `--badge-warning`, `--badge-warning-foreground`.
